title: Postdoctoral Position in Autoimmune Disease & Epigenetics - Dallas, Texas (US) job with The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center (UT Southwestern Medical Center) | 12862960
gist: This is a postdoctoral job listing, not an article: UT Southwestern's Choi Laboratory (Dept. of Dermatology / Center for Cellular Therapies and Cancer Immunology) is hiring to study epigenetic and T-cell mechanisms of lupus and autoimmune disease, explicitly aiming to advance findings toward first-in-human therapies.

themes.theme: Institutional research focus signaled by hiring

insights.claim: UT Southwestern's Choi Laboratory is recruiting a postdoc to study how epigenetic programs and environmental signals drive pathogenic T-cell responses in systemic lupus erythematosus and other autoimmune diseases, combining functional immunology with genomic/epigenomic approaches.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: A funded postdoc slot indicates continued institutional resourcing of a T-cell epigenetics/autoimmune disease research line, but it is a hiring signal, not a data or funding disclosure with investment implications.
insights.quote: investigate how environmental signals and epigenetic programs shape pathogenic T-cell responses in autoimmune disease

insights.claim: The lab's principal investigator, Dr. Jaehyuk Choi, is also a co-founder of the biotech company Moonlight Bio and directs UT Southwestern's Center for Cell Therapy and Cancer Immunology, and the posting states the lab's goal is to advance discoveries toward first-in-human studies.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
entities: Center for Cell Therapy and Cancer Immunology
insights.so_what: Shows an academic lab with a direct translational/biotech pipeline (co-founder role plus stated first-in-human ambition), a structural pattern worth tracking for potential future spinouts rather than a concrete investable event.
insights.quote: with the long-term goal of advancing promising treatments toward first-in-human studies at UT Southwestern
